extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Cigna plan available in Volusia County has a $35 monthly premium, a $30 drug deductible and a $5000 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, including delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment before scheduling the appointment. The call was for a Part D plan with Cigna.
composition.coaching_note: Owen did a great job following all the necessary steps. However, he could improve by providing a bit more detail about the plan's benefits, such as the specific drugs covered or the network of providers, to help the customer make an informed decision.

crm_record.next_step: Review and sign the Scope of Appointment, then schedule a follow-up call for plan review in 4 days.
